Present : Lokesha. C.N,
 M.A., Ll.,B.

 01st day of December 2025
 Complainant: State by - J.J.Nagar Police Station

(By A.P.P.)
 V/s  Accused:
 1. Mohammed Saleem Malik  S/o. Mukthar Pasha  A/a 34 years  R/o. No.9/1, 7th Cross  Hosahhli main road  Bengaluru-560 026.
 (By Sri. Baig & Baig Law Associates., Advocates)
 JUDGMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by J.J.Nagara Police station against the accused for the offence punishable Under Sections 498(A), 323, 341 of IPC.
C.C.No.28907/2024 2.
The case of the prosecution in brief is that, the marriage of the accused solemnized on 21.01.2017 with Cw.1 at Bengaluru as per their customs.
After the marriage the accused and complainant were residing at Hosahalli main road, Padarayanapura, Bengaluru.
Thereafter, the accused without any reason everyday used to quarrel with the complainant.
The accused used abused the Cw.1 with filthy language and used to assault her and subjected her physical and mental cruelty.
On 14.05.2024 at about 2.30 am the accused picked up quarrel with the complainant and assaulted her and subjected her physical and mental cruelty.
On the basis of the complaint given by the Cw.1, the Cw.10 registered a case in Cr.No.80/2024.

Thereafter the Cw.10 having completed the investigation filed J J Nagar Police Station vs Mohammed Saleem Malik on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26514042/
1 charge sheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.

sentences.text: 3. After filing of the charge sheet, the presence of the accused was secured.
Thereafter the copies of the charge sheet papers furnished to the accused and after hearing both sides, the charges were framed for the offence punishable under section 498A, 323, 341 of IPC.
The accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried for the said offences.
4. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused the prosecution examined one witnesses as P.W.1 and got marked documents as Ex.P.1 & P2.
PW1 being the complainant and being material witness has turned hostile and did not chose to support the case of prosecution.
Hence, the prayer of learned APP to issue summons to remaining C.C.No.28907/2024 witnesses was rejected as no purpose would have been served by examining remaining witnesses.
The statement of accused U/Section 313 of Cr.P.C., was also dispensed with as there were no incriminating circumstances against the accused in the evidence of Pw.1.
Thereafter, I have heard the arguments of both sides and perused the entire record, in the facts and circumstances of the case the following points arises for consideration.

:POINTS:
Point No.1: Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 498(A) of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?
Point No.2: Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 323 of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?
Point No.3: Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 341 of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?

5. Point No.1 to 3: under consideration are answered in the Negative for the following:
REASONS Point No.1 to 3:
6.
These points are inter-related; hence I have discussed them together to avoid repetition of facts and C.C.No.28907/2024 evidence.

The PSI of J.J.Nagara police station filed the charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable under Section 498(A), 323, 341 of IPC.
7.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution examined the complainant as P.W.1.
The PW.1 is the wife of the accused.

The Pw.1 being complainant and material witness has turned hostile to the case of prosecution, as she deposed in her evidence that, the she was not subjected any physical and mental cruelty from the accused.
The accused has not assaulted her not abused her with filthy language.
When the Pw.1 went police station at that time the police have obtain the signature of the Pw.1 and she does not know about the contents of the Ex.P.1 & P.2.
The Pw.1 did not lodged any complaint against the accused.

Hence, in view of fact that, the Pw.1 herself turned completely hostile to the case of prosecution, the prayer of learned APP to issue summons to J J Nagar Police Station vs Mohammed Saleem Malik on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26514042/
2 remaining witnesses was rejected as no purpose would have been served by examining the remaining witnesses.

sentences.text: The Ld.
APP treated the prosecution witness as hostile witness and cross-examined.
In the cross-examination also the Pw.1 did not chose to support the case of the prosecution and deposed the evidence in consonance with the chief examination.
The Pw.1 during the course of cross examination as clearly admitted that the matter was settled between the parties and she is residing with the accused.
Therefore, prosecution has failed to prove the guilty of the C.C.No.28907/2024 accused beyond all reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer point No.1 to 3 in the Negative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
Exercising the power under section 248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is acquitted for the offences punishable Under Section 498(A), 323, 341 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bonds stand cancelled.
(Dictated to the stenographer, transcribed and computerized by her corrected by me and then pronounced the judgment in the open court on 01st day of December 2025.)
(LOKESHA.C.N) 46th Addl.
C.J.M.,Bengaluru

.
